detailed_description: IBAN Validator is an IBAN checker online free for validating International Bank Account Numbers in the browser using the country code, registered IBAN length, and ISO 7064 MOD-97 checksum. Use it as an IBAN validator online when you need to validate IBAN online, normalize spacing, and review the formatted IBAN before saving payment data. It supports a broad local table of IBAN countries and territories, formats valid entries in groups of four, and shows the country, check digits, BBAN, and first BBAN block for quick review. The tool is useful for form QA, payment-data cleanup, support triage, and manual review before storing an IBAN string. It does not contact banks, verify account ownership, or confirm whether a transfer will be accepted by a payment provider.
usage_steps: Enter or paste an IBAN number in the input field.
Click the Validate button to remove spaces, normalize the country code, validate IBAN number length, and run the MOD-97 checksum checks.
Review the result details: country, check digits, BBAN prefix, BBAN, and formatted IBAN.
Use the sample IBAN buttons to test common country formats.
Copy the formatted IBAN when you need grouped spacing for documentation, forms, or manual review.
usage_examples: Use the IBAN checker online free to check whether a customer-provided IBAN has the right country length and checksum before storing it in a payment form.
Run validate IBAN online checks during form QA when pasted bank-account data has inconsistent spacing or lowercase country codes.
Normalize a pasted IBAN with inconsistent spacing into standard groups of four characters.
Test validation handling for German, UK, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and other IBAN country formats with an online IBAN validator.
Use the online IBAN checker as an IBAN account checker for structure only before sending the value to an official payment workflow.
Compare the displayed country and check digits against a support ticket before escalating payment-data cleanup.

faqs.question: What does the IBAN Validator check?
faqs.answer: It checks the country code, expected country-specific IBAN length, allowed format, and ISO 7064 MOD-97 checksum.

faqs.question: Why is my IBAN invalid?
faqs.answer: The result identifies the first failed check: basic format, supported country code, country-specific length, or MOD-97 checksum. Correct that part and validate again; a passing structure still does not prove that the bank account exists.

faqs.question: How does the MOD-97 checksum work?
faqs.answer: The validator moves the first four IBAN characters to the end, converts letters to numbers, and calculates the remainder in small chunks. A structurally valid IBAN has a remainder of 1.

faqs.question: Does this verify a real bank account?
faqs.answer: No. The validator checks IBAN structure and checksum only. It does not contact banks, verify account ownership, or confirm that a payment transfer will succeed.

faqs.question: Can I use it as an online IBAN checker?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use it as an online IBAN checker or IBAN validator online for formatting, country length, and MOD-97 checksum review, not for bank-account ownership verification.

faqs.question: Can I format an IBAN with spaces?
faqs.answer: Yes. Valid IBANs are formatted in groups of four characters so they are easier to read, copy, and compare with forms or documents.

faqs.question: Which IBAN details are shown?
faqs.answer: For valid entries, the tool shows the country, country code, check digits, BBAN, first BBAN block, and formatted IBAN.

faqs.question: Should I rely on it before sending money?
faqs.answer: Use it as a structure and checksum check only. Confirm payment instructions, recipient details, and bank requirements through your official payment workflow.
